description: This source file defines a Kotlin class `HomeFragment` which extends `BrowseSupportFragment` from Android's Leanback library, used to create a TV-optimized home screen with multiple horizontal rows of media items, each represented by custom card views (`ImageCardView`) with focus scaling and progress indicators. Additionally, it includes data classes and custom presenter classes for rendering media cards with specific styling and behavior.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data class representing a media item card with a title, image resource ID, and progress value.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: A PresenterSelector that returns an instance of OPImageCardPresenter for rendering CardItem objects.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom ImageCardViewPresenter that styles images, applies focus scaling and highlighting, and overlays a progress bar indicating media progress.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView with custom focus behavior and styling.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a CardItem to the ImageCardView, setting title, image, and overlaying a progress bar based on progress value.

methods.name: buildProgressBar
methods.description: Constructs a progress bar view with background and foreground indicating the media progress.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Resets the ImageCardView to release resources.
